title: Tiny, cute roller skate
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- boot body -->
  <path d="M30 55 L30 30 Q30 25 35 25 L55 25 Q60 25 60 30 L60 50 L65 55 L65 62 L28 62 Q25 62 25 58 L25 55 Z" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- boot highlight -->
  <path d="M33 30 Q33 28 36 28 L54 28 Q57 28 57 30 L57 45 L33 45 Z" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <!-- boot cuff / top trim -->
  <rect x="30" y="24" width="30" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ffb8d8"/>
  <!-- laces area -->
  <rect x="40" y="28" width="12" height="14" rx="2" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <!-- lace holes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="32" r="1.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- sole -->
  <rect x="24" y="60" width="43" height="7" rx="3" fill="#7bc8f6"/>
  <!-- heel -->
  <rect x="55" y="67" width="12" height="10" rx="2" fill="#4aa8d8"/>
  <!-- toe stop -->
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="68" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <ellipse cx="27" cy="68" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#ffe599"/>
  <!-- front wheels -->
  <circle cx="35" cy="77" r="6" fill="#a78bfa"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="77" r="3" fill="#c4b5fd"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="77" r="1.2" fill="#ede9fe"/>
  <!-- back wheels -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="77" r="6" fill="#a78bfa"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="77" r="3" fill="#c4b5fd"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="77" r="1.2" fill="#ede9fe"/>
  <!-- axle -->
  <rect x="33" y="75" width="27" height="4" rx="2" fill="#6d28d9"/>
  <!-- cute eye on boot -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="3" fill="#ffd166"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#5b2a00"/>
  <!-- tiny smile -->
  <path d="M38 56 Q41 59 44 56" stroke="#ffd166" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <path d="M68 28 L70 33 L75 33 L71 36 L72 41 L68 38 L64 41 L65 36 L61 33 L66 33 Z" fill="#ffe066"/>
</svg>
